retrievalProfile.description: A centered, vertically-oriented elliptical monogram with a chiseled metallic texture against a stark black background.
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn styles are requested
bright or colorful backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central typographic emblem where characters are distorted to fit within a vertical oval or diamond-like silhouette, featuring a heavy metallic bronze texture with internal beveling and a high-contrast black backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right halves of the central emblem
Contrast between the warm bronze texture and the cold black void
Hierarchy between the large central monogram and the small supporting footer text
Alignment of the footer text along a horizontal axis with diamond separators
coreInvariants: Elliptical or convex outer boundary of the main text block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary monogram is centered and occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tall central characters of the monogram act as the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright center of the monogram, moves outward to the edges of the ellipse, then drops to the small footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central element to emphasize its metallic sheen.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bronze/Copper metallic tones for the primary subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue-grey for the secondary footer text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic highlights and the zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are vertically elongated in the center and compressed toward the sides
Outer edges of the letters follow a curved, elliptical path
Internal strokes feature a chiseled, triangular bevel
Serifs are sharp and integrated into the overall silhouette
characterSpecificRedesigns: Central characters are the tallest with pointed tops and bottoms
Peripheral characters are shorter and curved to complete the oval shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, textured custom monogram paired with a clean, wide-tracked minimalist sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Diamond-shaped glyphs used as separators in the footer text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar sharp serifs and sturdy construction for the base skeleton.
Good for the wide-tracked footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with a subtle central vignette. Place a textured bronze/copper elliptical shape in the center with a chiseled 3D effect, but without specific letterforms.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom vector lettering over the central shape using an envelope distort tool to fit the elliptical boundary. Add a secondary line of wide-tracked sans-serif text at the bottom separated by small diamond icons.

verificationChecks: Does the texture look like real brushed metal?
Is the footer text tracking wide enough to span the width of the monogram?
Are the bevels consistent with a central light source?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the footer text
mustRedesign: Specific letter combinations from the original

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the 3D bevels

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetry in the monogram warp
Ensure the bronze color doesn't look muddy
Verify the footer text is legible against the black
Confirm the elliptical shape is clearly defined
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Text] in [Metal Texture] with [Elliptical Warp] + [Wide-Tracked Footer] on [Black Background]
